name: echosign
description: EchoSign: Sign Language & Speech-to-Text Classroom Assistant. Converts speech and supported sign-language gestures into real-time text captions for deaf and hard-of-hearing students.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix backend ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix backend test -- --coverage=false
